subject: Request: Purchase guideline variance for SimpliCloud pilot
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T09:22:00Z
Subject: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot next Monday. I wanted to surface a procurement constraint on our side: our AP team processes purchase orders on a 7–10 business day cadence, and our legal team prefers invoices tied to an SOW for short pilots.

Would Redwood be open to a temporary invoices-only onboarding for this pilot while we get a PO in flight? We can provide a signed SOW and W-9 immediately (attached). We understand this is an exception to standard purchase rules and are happy to accept any guardrails you require (e.g., spend cap, shortened invoice terms).

Appreciate a quick thumbs up if this is workable — we want to avoid delaying the start.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Partnerships | SimpliCloud
[Attachment: SimpliCloud_SOW.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SimpliCloud_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

Sara — thanks for sending the SOW and W-9.

Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only route for a short pilot, but procurement needs to approve a controlled variance. Markus and David, looping you in — can procurement authorize a one-off variance provided SimpliCloud signs the SOW and we limit spend to $12,000 for the pilot?

If procurement approves, I will open the onboarding ticket and mark the account as "pilot invoice route - conditional" in our system. Please call out any specific invoice remit instructions in your next note.

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

On 2028-01-18 09:22, Sara Patel wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot next Monday. I wanted to surface a procurement constraint on our side: our AP team processes purchase orders on a 7–10 business day cadence...

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T13:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

Priya / David — happy to evaluate. A couple of operational points before we lock this in:

- Variance duration: propose a 45-day window (covering the 6-week pilot plus buffer).
- Spend cap: $12,000 hard cap; any overage requires retro approval.
- Evidence: require customer-signed SOW and W-9 on file (Sara already provided).
- Invoice cadence: invoices to accounts@redwood.billing with a 30-day net term; we will not process longer-term commitments without a PO.
- Risk: require an explicit acceptance from the SimpliCloud finance contact that a PO will follow.

If David and reports confirm we can track and flag this in the billing ledger, I can approve the variance and Priya can proceed with onboarding.

Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference

On 2028-01-18 10:03, Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Sara — thanks for sending the SOW and W-9. Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only route for a short pilot, but procurement needs to approve a controlled variance...

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>
Date: 2028-01-19T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

Markus / Priya — I reviewed the intake data and SOW. Operationally this is acceptable under the following conditions:

1) Create an onboarding flag in our billing system: "TEMP_INVOICE_ROUTE_SIMPLICLOUD_2028-01" that automatically triggers daily reconciliation until a PO arrives.
2) AP will hold invoices in a separate queue and require invoice line-items to match the SOW exactly. Any discrepancy pauses approval.
3) SimpliCloud must provide a named finance contact and agree to deliver a PO within 10 business days of pilot start. If PO not received, procurement will escalate and block further invoicing beyond the cap.

If those controls are in place, I approve the variance for 45 days with the $12,000 cap. Priya, please confirm you will create the ticket and mark the account accordingly. Sara, please send the finance contact and preferred remit address.

-David
David Kim
Senior AP Manager | Redwood Inference

On 2028-01-18 13:12, Markus Klein wrote:
> Priya / David — happy to evaluate. A couple of operational points before we lock this in:...

From: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-19T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

Thanks all — this is great. Confirming SimpliCloud agrees to the conditions below:

- 45-day temporary variance, $12,000 cap
- Signed SOW and W-9 attached (same as earlier)
- Finance contact: Luis Ortega, luis.ortega@simplicloud.com
- Remit: payments@simpli-cloud.com (Same as accounts@ but please use payments@ for invoicing)
- We will aim to submit a PO within 7 business days of pilot start; will escalate internally if delayed.

Next steps requested from Redwood: please create the onboarding ticket and share the internal flag/id so our billing team can reference it when they send invoices. Also, confirm whether we should route the first invoice at pilot midpoint or at completion.

Best,
Sara
Head of Partnerships | SimpliCloud
[Attachment: SimpliCloud_SOW.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@simplicloud.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-20T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — pilot onboarding and PO timing

All — variance approved and intake ticket created. Details and ticket ID below: 

Ticket: ONB-2028-1198 (Pilot invoice-only variance)
Internal flag: TEMP_INVOICE_ROUTE_SIMPLICLOUD_2028-01
Variance window: 2028-01-20 to 2028-03-05 (45 days)
Spend cap: $12,000
Invoice remit: payments@simpli-cloud.com
First invoice: please submit at pilot midpoint (week 3); we will accept interim invoices but will reconcile against the SOW exactly.

David — procurement asked that AP tag any invoice that exceeds the line-item match as "HOLD" and notify the intake queue. Markus — please confirm if you want a follow-up review at PO arrival.

Sara — welcome aboard. I'll send the onboarding checklist and a short kickoff agenda separately.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
